title: Understanding Data Representation
text: When data is represented by its relationship to other data points, it often involves a structure that can capture these relationships effectively. Think about how connections or links between data points can be visualized.

title: Visualizing Relationships
text: Consider a structure that is commonly used in computer science to represent relationships or connections between entities. This structure is often used in network analysis.

title: Identifying the Structure
text: What is the term for a structure that represents data through nodes and edges, often used to depict relationships?
